verdict.rationale: Smithery is an API-bearing platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The only related item is a shutdown notice that marked then-current versions deprecated, and it states there is no longer a documented API surface to version. That is a one-off service shutdown, not a published deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
